Create your 14-day free trial account in the EchoDesk app

EchoDesk is a mobile app. There is no browser signup. Get the app, tap Create account, and pick one of five professional voices for your receptionist.

1. Get the app

App Store and Google Play listings are coming soon. If you already have EchoDesk installed, open it from your phone. Need a build? Email echodesk2@gmail.com.

2. Create your account

On the first screen, tap Create account. Use the email you want for billing and confirmations.

3. Confirm your email

Open the confirmation link from your inbox. You should return to the app (or open the app and log in with the same email).

4. Connect your calendar and pick a voice

Connect Google Calendar, create a receptionist, and choose one of five professional voices. EchoDesk answers calls and books from your real availability.
